claims.statement: Partner scoping is enforced server-side in two layers — Casbin policy for endpoint-level access and handler-level checks via isScopedPartnerRole plus CanUserAccessProject / CanUserAccessEmployee — so the frontend never re-implements the filter.
The advanced-partner role (adv-partner) extends partner with additional write rights; its page tree currently includes UsersPage for managing employee user accounts within the partner's projects.

The bank-transfer history endpoint /api/v1/payrolls/bank-transfer-histories returns the same response shape to partner and admin but the server filters to accessible projects and returns only those rows; cycle windows are fixed at Days 1-7 / 8-14 / 15-21 / 22-28.

The mobile partner tree is intentionally narrower than the desktop tree (Dashboard, Projects, Employees, Timesheets) because the partner does not run payroll or read the full payment history from a phone.
All partner UI copy is Vietnamese inline; labels like Duyệt chấm công, Yêu cầu tạm ứng, Lịch sử thanh toán live in the component files.
